name: SpicetifyFM (Last.fm Scrobbler)
description: A pure in-app Last.fm & ListenBrainz scrobbler inspired by Pano Scrobbler — zero third-party apps or external servers required. Features in-tracklist scrobble badges, total artist/album scrobbles, Top Charts & Stats dashboard (#1–25 tracks/artists/albums with period filters), ListenBrainz dual-scrobbling, daily listening streaks & milestone celebrations, saved metadata edits, Regex cleaners, and offline retry queue.
